name: @vertigo/plugin
description: VERTIGO OS Plugin package: governing 0.3 manifest + guarded candidate skill. Exposes exactly six tools through a Notion-read-only harness; backend transaction state and verified runtime-registry activation remain server-side, while physical Notion writes use the native Notion app.

scripts.build: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8')); if (m.tools.length!==6) throw new Error('six tools'); console.log('manifest ok')"
